theme.localOverrides: data-theme on a subtree; custom portals copy the nearest theme/accent/borders and establish floating surface context

surface.customContainer: Set background:var(--cap-surface-current) to match the declared surface
affects: neutral control fills and hover/active states

borders.effect: off makes decorative boundaries transparent; on restores boundaries without changing geometry or state fills

sizes.note: at 16px root; touch targets expand separately; ActionBar and ButtonGroup size coordinate nested controls, while popup content keeps its own size

accent.compatibility: data-color is an alias; gray aliases neutral

tokens.architecture: Full 417-color original palettes. Primitives groups palette, number and font; Theme has Light/Dark modes, Semantic has Base/Canvas/Raised/Floating modes and four explicit interaction states. Runtime CSS and Figma use identical palette references.
tokens.compatibility: --cap-bg-*, --cap-text-* and established border aliases remain available. Full palettes are canonical runtime primitives; source editor roles are retained for provenance.

Button.props: variant?: primary|secondary|outline|ghost|danger|accent; size?: xs|sm|md|lg|xl; loading?: boolean; leading?, trailing?: ReactNode; native button props
Button.behavior: Outline is transparent at rest with a persistent semantic border, including Borders Off; hover/pressed are neutral reactions. type=button by default; loading disables repeat activation. Neutral secondary fills use inherited surface/border context; primary and accent variants share the solid pair of the nearest accent mode; data-accent="neutral" selects the neutral Primary.

Icon.props: name: IconSource (built-in name or directly imported Lucide component); size?: number; SVG props

Tag.purpose: Universal label, object tag and type chip
Tag.props: size?: Size; shape?: rounded|pill; variant?: soft|solid|outline; icon?: IconSource; count?: number|string; counter?: {variant,shape,max}; interactive?: boolean (false disables interaction); action?: {icon,label,onClick}; color?: Color; disabled?: boolean; onClick?: button click handler; onRemove?: () => void; children; span props
Tag.behavior: Unified label with optional icon/count/action. Badge and TypeLabel are compatibility wrappers. Omitting color inherits the nearest data-accent. interactive=false makes every slot static; otherwise selection/removal use independent native buttons and one shared hover surface. Disabled prevents both actions and uses opaque neutral colors.

Counter.props: value: number|string; size?: Size; variant?: neutral|translucent|accent|white|black|plain (soft alias); shape?: round|rounded; color?: Color; max?: number; span props

TextAction.purpose: Text link or action with background reaction
TextAction.props: href?: string; native anchor or button props

ContentLayout.purpose: Concurrent resizable left and right content panes
ContentLayout.props: left?, right?: ContentPane {content,label,open?,onOpenChange?,width?,defaultWidth?,minWidth?,maxWidth?,onWidthChange?,height?,defaultHeight?,minHeight?,maxHeight?,onHeightChange?,contentWidth?,surface?:base|canvas|raised|floating}; orientation?: horizontal|vertical (horizontal); divider?: always|hover|none (hover); stretch?: boolean (true, main fill); contentWidth?: number|string; label?; children; div props
ContentLayout.behavior: Horizontal uses pane widths; vertical uses pane heights. Divider paint is always/hover/none while keyboard resize stays accessible. stretch=false stops the main content from filling available space. Each pane owns its declared surface; main content uses base.

IconPicker.props: focusRing?: {width?: number, offset?: number}; value?: string; onValueChange: (name:string)=>void; options?: {name,icon:IconSource,keywords?}[]; iconSize?: number; variant?: grid|combobox; size?: Size; id?: string; disabled?: boolean; label?: string

IconBox.props: icon: IconName; color?: Color; size?: xs|sm|md|lg|xl
IconBox.behavior: Omitting color inherits the nearest data-accent mode.

Avatar.props: name: string; src?: string; size?: xs|sm|md|lg|xl

Separator.props: orientation?: horizontal|vertical; length?: number|string; contrast?: subtle|normal|strong; reveal?: always|hover; hr props

Progress.props: label: string; value: number (clamped 0–100); div props

Input.purpose: Native input-backed text and form control
Input.props: focusRing?: {width?: number, offset?: number}; size?: Size; variant?: surface|ghost; label?, hint?, error?; labelPlacement?: outside|inside; leading?, trailing?; native input props except numeric size; ref; avoid browser-picker types date|time|datetime-local|month|week|color in finished UI

Textarea.props: focusRing?: {width?: number, offset?: number}; size?: Size; variant?: surface|ghost; label?, hint?, error?; labelPlacement?: outside|inside; native textarea props; ref

Select.purpose: Custom single-select popup with native form backing
Select.props: focusRing?: {width?: number, offset?: number}; value?, defaultValue?: string|number; onValueChange?: (value: string) => void; options?: {value,label,disabled?,group?}[] or option children; size?: Size; variant?: surface|ghost; label?, hint?, error?; labelPlacement?: outside|inside; placeholder?; popupClassName?: string; scrubbable?: boolean (default false); scrubOrientation?: horizontal|vertical; native single-select props; ref: HTMLSelectElement
Select.behavior: Arrows/Home/End and typeahead navigate; Enter/Space choose; Escape dismisses. Hidden native select preserves form values, required validation, reset and change events. scrubbable=true opts into Alt+drag and Alt+arrow selection across enabled options.

Field.props: label: string; hint?, error?: string; required?: boolean; children: props => ReactNode

Checkbox.props: label: ReactNode; size?: Size; contrast?: boolean (default true: solid Primary pair; false: vivid); indeterminate?: boolean; native input props

Radio.props: label: ReactNode; size?: Size; contrast?: boolean (default true: solid Primary pair; false: vivid); native input props; shared name per group

Switch.props: label: ReactNode; size?: Size; color?: Color; variant?: accent|neutral; contrast?: boolean (default true: solid Primary pair; false: vivid); native checkbox props

Slider.purpose: Accessible numeric range with a custom track and native input
Slider.props: label: string; size?: Size; showValue?: boolean; contrast?: boolean; onValueChange?, onValueCommit?: (value:number)=>void; formatValue?: (value:number)=>string; focusRing?; native range props
Slider.behavior: Native range, form/reset and onChange are preserved. onValueChange emits numbers; onValueCommit emits on pointer/key release. formatValue also supplies aria-valuetext. Focus remains around the thumb.

SegmentedControl.props: label: string; value: string; onValueChange: (value) => void; options: {value,label,disabled?,icon?}[]; size?: Size; variant?: surface|outline|accent|ghost; fullWidth?: boolean; div props

Card.behavior: Own surface is raised for default/elevated and canvas for subtle; nested controls use that context. Decorative borders follow data-borders.

ObjectCard.props: title: string; description?: string; icon?: IconName; color?: Color; meta?, cover?: ReactNode; button props

CollectionRow.props: title: string; icon?: IconName; color?: Color; meta?: ReactNode; button props

SidebarItem.props: icon?: IconSource; active?: boolean; count?: number; color?: Color|inherit (neutral); children; button props

PropertyRow.props: label: string; icon?: IconName; children; div props

Breadcrumbs.props: items: {label,href?}[]; label?: string (unique across multiple navs)

Callout.props: color?: Color; icon?: IconName; title?: string; children; div props

EmptyState.props: title: string; icon?: IconName|false (default folder, neutral and muted); description?: string; action?: ReactNode
EmptyState.behavior: Optional decorative icon is always neutral and quieter than content; omit with icon=false. Keep one useful next action.

Accordion.props: title: ReactNode; variant?: default|navigation|bouncy; icon?: IconSource; defaultOpen?: boolean; onOpenChange?: (open:boolean)=>void; expandLabel?, collapseLabel?: string; children; native details props

Tabs.props: label: string; value: string; onValueChange: (value:string)=>void; size?: Size; variant?: line|pills|segment|outline|accent; items: {value,label,content,disabled?,count?,color?:Color|inherit}[]; scrollLabels?: {previous:string,next:string}; className?
Tabs.behavior: Arrows/Home/End skip disabled tabs and select immediately; horizontal arrows respect RTL. One active tab stop; unique values and valid active value. Overflow adds physical edge controls/masks; selected and focused reveal scrolls only the local viewport.

Table.purpose: Static data table with scroll region
Table.props: caption: string; columns: string[]; rows: ReactNode[][]; className?

CodeBlock.purpose: Escaped code with an interactive language selector, contextual fill and copy action
CodeBlock.props: children: string; label?: string; language?: text|tsx|ts|js|json|css|bash; defaultLanguage?: same (text); onLanguageChange?; showLanguageSelector?: boolean (true); color?: Color|inherit (neutral); copyable?: boolean; actions?: ReactNode; wrap?: boolean (false); variant?: auto|surface|outline|filled-outline; showActionsMenu?: boolean; contextActions?: MenuItem[]; onWrapChange?: (wrap:boolean)=>void; editor?: ReactNode
CodeBlock.behavior: Optional label, safe escaped syntax highlighting and exact-source copy. Menu beside copy controls wrapping and contextActions. editor supplies editable content without a nested framed pre. filled-outline explicitly combines fill and outline; auto follows Borders context.

Dialog.purpose: Custom inset modal with backdrop and focus restoration
Dialog.props: open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open) => void; title: string; description?: string; children; footer?: ReactNode; size?: sm|md|lg|xl; closeLabel?: string; dismissOnOutside?: boolean
Dialog.behavior: Controlled custom portal; Tab trapping, Escape, focus restoration, inert background and scroll locking. Own surface is floating; nearest theme/accent/borders are preserved. Overlay gutter is 12px.

Drawer.purpose: Inset side panel with modal behavior
Drawer.props: DialogProps; side?: left|right|bottom (default right); variant?: inset|edge
Drawer.behavior: Same modal contract as Dialog, with left/right/bottom placement.

Tooltip.purpose: Portaled hover/focus hint with optional keycaps
Tooltip.props: content: ReactNode; caption?: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; variant?: default|inverse; arrow?: boolean; side?: top|bottom (top); align?: start|center|end (center); shortcut?: string[]; children: one focusable ReactElement forwarding aria-describedby
Tooltip.example: <Tooltip content="Focus mode" shortcut={["⇧", "⌘", "M"]}><IconButton label="Focus mode" icon="grid" /></Tooltip>
Tooltip.behavior: Hover or focus shows the non-interactive hint; Escape dismisses; caption/content/description combine in aria-describedby. Inverse keeps local theme with reversed semantic contrast. Optional arrow follows the actual placement. Keycaps do not register shortcuts.

Menu.props: label: string; icon?: IconName; disabled?: boolean; size?: Size; variant?: ButtonProps.variant; items: {id,label,icon?,shortcut?,disabled?,danger?,separator?,onSelect?}[]
Menu.behavior: Shared moving hover is separate from keyboard focus/selection. Arrows/Home/End/typeahead skip disabled entries; Escape restores trigger focus; outside pointer dismisses.

Popover.purpose: Custom anchored information or form popup
Popover.props: label: string; triggerContent?: ReactNode; triggerIcon?: IconSource; children: ReactNode; open?: boolean; onOpenChange?: (open) => void; align?: start|center|end; side?: top|bottom; disabled?: boolean; size?: Size (trigger only); className?
Popover.behavior: triggerContent customizes its accessible labelled trigger; triggerIcon renders a labelled IconButton without a chevron. Optional controlled state; Escape/outside dismiss; position is clamped to viewport gutters. Own floating surface preserves theme/accent/borders/radius/shadow. size affects the trigger; popup content does not inherit toolbar sizing.

CommandPalette.purpose: Local command search in a modal
CommandPalette.props: open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open) => void; items: {id,label,description?,icon?,shortcut?,onSelect}[]; placeholder?: string
CommandPalette.behavior: Shared hover is separate from selected command. Filters locally; arrows select, Enter activates, Escape dismisses. The consumer registers any global shortcut.

Toast.props: title: string; description?: string; onDismiss?: ()=>void; icon?, action?: ReactNode; tone?: neutral|info|success|warning|danger; color?: Color|inherit; appearance?: neutral|soft|solid (neutral); contrast?: boolean (false); surface?: inherit|base|canvas|raised|floating (surface floating); div props
Toast.behavior: Consumer owns placement and lifetime; action is an ordinary accessible slot. Floating surface by default, inherit for inline composition. Neutral shell preserves local accent; colored status icon, explicit soft/solid appearance and contrast.

ScrollArea.purpose: Native scroll viewport with themed scrollbar and overflow shadows
ScrollArea.props: label: string; axis?: vertical|horizontal|both; scrollbar?: auto|hidden (default hidden for horizontal, auto otherwise); shadows?: boolean; floating?: ReactNode (outside viewport); viewportProps?, viewportClassName?, contentClassName?; onEdgesChange?: ({top,right,bottom,left}) => void; ref: scrolling div; root div props
ScrollArea.behavior: Set a height or constrained parent for vertical overflow. Native wheel/touch/keyboard scrolling remains with scrollbar=auto or hidden. Horizontal defaults hidden; vertical/both auto. Edge masks reveal existing background, not a tinted overlay. Ref and viewportProps target the scrolling node.

ButtonGroup.props: label: string; attached?: boolean; size?: Size; orientation?: horizontal|vertical; prefix?: ReactNode; color?: Color|inherit (neutral); children; div props
ButtonGroup.example: <ButtonGroup label="View" prefix={count}><IconButton label="List" icon="list" /><IconButton label="Grid" icon="grid" /></ButtonGroup>
ButtonGroup.behavior: Groups real buttons without nesting them; each button retains native keyboard behavior. size sets the outer height including attached-group padding; omitted size inherits the enclosing ActionBar or defaults to md.

SplitButton.purpose: Primary action and separate custom action menu
SplitButton.props: label: string; menuLabel?: string; layout?: joined|separated (default joined); items: MenuItem[]; ButtonProps except children/trailing
SplitButton.behavior: Joined or separated layout; two independent buttons, disabled/loading disables both.

ActionBar.props: label: string; size?: Size; orientation?: horizontal|vertical; rovingFocus?: boolean (default true); children; div props
ActionBar.behavior: One tab stop by default; arrows/Home/End move across enabled actions. size unifies nested button/input heights, icons, insets and counts; nested groups can override it. Set rovingFocus=false for forms and complex controls.

FloatingActionBar.props: ActionBarProps {label,orientation?,rovingFocus?}; size?: xs|sm|md|lg|xl; leading?, trailing?: ReactNode; variant?: surface|divided; action?: {label,icon: IconSource,onClick,variant?: primary|accent,disabled?}; position?: static|sticky (default sticky); div props
FloatingActionBar.behavior: Positioning stays inside its container; it does not install a fixed viewport overlay. Uses floating surface context and inherited border mode; accepts xs through xl and leading/trailing slots. In a ScrollArea, use its floating prop so masks cannot clip the shadow; measured overlay height reserves content clearance.

FloatingField.purpose: Input with persistent inside label and linked validation
FloatingField.props: focusRing?: {width?: number, offset?: number}; label: string; hint?: ReactNode; error?: string; leading?, trailing?: ReactNode; inputClassName?; size?: Size; variant?: surface|ghost; native input props except numeric size; ref: input
FloatingField.behavior: Compatibility wrapper over Input labelPlacement=inside. Input, Select and Textarea share label, hint, error and outside/inside placement; do not duplicate a Field label.

StatusBar.props: tone?: neutral|info|success|warning|danger; color?: Color|inherit; appearance?: neutral|soft|solid (neutral); contrast?: boolean (false); surface?: inherit|base|canvas|raised|floating (surface inherit); variant?: plain|surface (plain); leading?, trailing?: ReactNode; busy?: boolean; children; div props
StatusBar.behavior: role=status with polite announcements; busy marks in-progress work. variant=plain is transparent by default; surface paints current surface. Neutral appearance scopes status hue only on its icon; soft/solid intentionally color the shell. Contrast and surface are explicit.

Alert.purpose: Status or alert with optional disclosure and dismissal
Alert.props: title: ReactNode; tone?: neutral|info|success|warning|danger; color?: Color|inherit; appearance?: neutral|soft|solid (neutral); contrast?: boolean (false); surface?: inherit|base|canvas|raised|floating (surface inherit); icon?: ReactNode; expandable?: boolean; expanded?, defaultExpanded?: boolean; onExpandedChange?: (expanded:boolean)=>void; onDismiss?: ()=>void; dismissLabel?: string; children; div props
Alert.example: <Alert tone="success" title="Saved" expandable defaultExpanded>All changes are stored locally.</Alert>
Alert.behavior: Optional controlled/uncontrolled expansion; collapsed content is inert and hidden from assistive technology. Dismiss button is separate from disclosure. Neutral appearance preserves local accent; status hue is scoped to the icon. soft/solid, contrast and surface are explicit.

SidebarPanel.purpose: Sidebar with fixed header/footer and scrollable middle
SidebarPanel.props: label: string; header?, footer?: ReactNode; footerAlign?: start|center|end|stretch (start); width?: CSSProperties.width; surface?: base|canvas|raised|floating (canvas); children; aside props
SidebarPanel.example: <SidebarPanel label="Workspace" header="My space" footerAlign="end" style={{height: 480}} footer={<FloatingActionBar label="Tools" position="static">…</FloatingActionBar>}><Accordion title="Projects" variant="navigation" open>…</Accordion></SidebarPanel>
SidebarPanel.behavior: Constrain its height; header/footer stay outside the middle ScrollArea. Header is a caption; footer is muted and padded, with compact start/end/center or explicit stretch alignment. Compose groups with Accordion variant=navigation and SidebarItem count/color. Surface defaults to canvas; choose surface explicitly to adapt secondary controls.

Calendar.purpose: Controlled single-date or range calendar with one/two months and day schedules
Calendar.props: mode?: single|range; single: value?, onValueChange(date); range: range?: {start,end?}, onRangeChange(range); numberOfMonths?: 1|2 (range default 2); defaultMonth?, today?, min?, max?: YYYY-MM-DD; isDateUnavailable?; locale?; events?: {id,date,title,time?,description?,color?,emphasis?: title|time}[]; showAgenda?; agendaPosition?: bottom|side; eventEmphasis?: title|time; showEventPreview?: boolean (true); highlightedDates?: (YYYY-MM-DD|{date,label?,color?})[]; yearRange?: [number,number]; label?
Calendar.behavior: Local date strings, Monday-first grid. Arrows move by day/week; Home/End by week; PageUp/PageDown by month (Shift: year); Enter/Space selects enabled dates. Range endpoints normalize reverse selection; unavailable interior days restart the range. Year ComboBox supports typed search; day schedules appear on hover/focus.

DatePicker.purpose: Calendar inside a custom dismissible popover
DatePicker.props: CalendarProps | CalendarRangeProps (CalendarSelectionProps); label defaults to date-picker label
DatePicker.behavior: Uses Calendar in a context-preserving Popover. Single selection closes immediately; range closes after its end is selected. Nested year search and event previews retain the parent popup.

MarkdownPreview.behavior: Supports headings, paragraphs, emphasis, links, lists/tasks, quotes, code and dividers. Escapes HTML and filters link protocols; not a full CommonMark parser.

MarkdownEditor.purpose: Controlled Markdown textarea with formatting and preview
MarkdownEditor.props: value: string; onValueChange: (value) => void; label: string; placeholder?: string; disabled?, readOnly?: boolean; defaultMode?: edit|preview|split; onSave?: () => void
MarkdownEditor.example: <MarkdownEditor label="Daily note" value={note} onValueChange={setNote} defaultMode="split" onSave={save} />
MarkdownEditor.behavior: Archived compatibility export; old catalogue route resolves to RichTextEditor. Cmd/Ctrl+B and I format selection; Cmd/Ctrl+Enter calls onSave. State/persistence belongs to the consumer; edit/preview/split modes are local.

ReorderableList.props: label: string; items: readonly T[] (stable unique id); onOrderChange: (items:T[]) => void; getItemLabel; renderItem(item,{index,handle,dragging}); handlePlacement?: start|custom; disabled?; className?
ReorderableList.example: <ReorderableList label="Projects" items={items} onOrderChange={setItems} getItemLabel={i => i.title} renderItem={i => i.title} />
ReorderableList.behavior: Controlled vertical order, stable unique IDs. Pointer/touch drag starts only on handle. ArrowUp/Down/Home/End move; Escape cancels an uncommitted drag. Clicking handle exposes equivalent move buttons. Consumer persists order.

ContentCard.purpose: Configurable article card with independent controls
ContentCard.props: title: ReactNode; blocks?: readonly ContentCardBlock[] {id,content,kind?,hidden?}; blockOrder?: readonly string[]; hiddenBlocks?: readonly string[]; dragHandle?: ReactNode; description?,header?,metadata?,footer?,cover?,actions?: ReactNode; onOpen?: ()=>void; selectable?: boolean (omitted: enabled by onSelectedChange); selected?: boolean; onSelectedChange?: (selected:boolean)=>void; selectionLabel?; selectionPosition?: top-start|top-end; density?: compact|comfortable; orientation?: vertical|horizontal; headingLevel?: 2|3|4; article props
ContentCard.example: <ContentCard title="Project" description="Next steps" onOpen={open} selected={selected} onSelectedChange={setSelected} actions={<Menu label="Project actions" items={actions} />} />
ContentCard.behavior: selectable=false suppresses selection even with a callback; selectable=true allows local selection when uncontrolled. blockOrder lists IDs first, unlisted blocks append; hiddenBlocks hides them without dropping data. Custom blocks can override IDs. A leading cover supports horizontal layout; an inline reordered cover follows the body. Corner selection stays outside block composition and survives hidden/reordered headers. Article composition permits independent checkboxes/buttons/links. Own surface is raised. onOpen makes the title an action; the whole card is not a button.

TaskCard.purpose: Task article with completion and action menu
TaskCard.props: title: string; typeLabel?: string; color?: Color (default rose); completed?: boolean; onCompletedChange?: (completed) => void; menuItems?: MenuItem[]; other ContentCardProps except title/header/actions
TaskCard.example: <TaskCard title="Plan the week" completed={done} onCompletedChange={setDone} metadata={<Tag>Personal</Tag>} />
TaskCard.behavior: Completion, title action and menu are independent controls. Consumer owns completed state.

KanbanColumn.purpose: Named column with count, action and empty state
KanbanColumn.props: title: string; count?: number; color?: Color|inherit (neutral); action?,emptyState?: ReactNode; children; section props including explicit data-surface (inherited by default)
KanbanColumn.behavior: Inherits composition surface; heading color affects only heading/count. Omitted color is neutral; inherit uses the local accent. Own cards remain raised.

KanbanBoard.purpose: Controlled task lanes with menu-based movement
KanbanBoard.props: label: string; columns: KanbanLane[] {id,title,emptyMessage?,color?:Color|inherit}; items: KanbanTask[] {id,columnId,title,description?,completed?,color?,metadata?,footer?}; onMove?: (id:string,columnId:string)=>void; onCompletedChange?: (id:string,completed:boolean)=>void; onOpen?: (id:string)=>void; onAdd?: (columnId:string)=>void; renderCard?: (item:KanbanTask)=>ReactNode; className?
KanbanBoard.behavior: Consumer owns columns/items/moves. Default cards expose target-column actions in a keyboard-accessible menu; no drag-and-drop runtime.

DailyHeader.purpose: Localized date, weekday and ISO week header
DailyHeader.props: date: YYYY-MM-DD; locale?: string; showWeek?: boolean; tags?, actions?: ReactNode; headingLevel?: 1|2|3; children; header props
DailyHeader.example: <DailyHeader date="2026-09-25" tags={<Tag icon="check" color="rose">Tasks</Tag>} actions={<Button onClick={create}>New note</Button>} />
DailyHeader.behavior: Uses local YYYY-MM-DD dates and ISO week numbering; locale defaults to ru-RU.

TreeView.props: nodes: TreeNode[]; label: string; selectedId?, onSelect?, expandedIds?, defaultExpandedIds?, onExpandedChange?, size?, showGuides?, className?; TreeNode {id,label,icon?,children?,disabled?,meta?,href?}
TreeView.example: <TreeView label="Projects" nodes={nodes} selectedId={selected} onSelect={node => setSelected(node.id)} showGuides />

NavigationMenu.props: label: string; items: NavigationMenuItem[] {id,label,href?,content?,disabled?,onSelect?}; activeId?, size?, leading?, trailing?, className?

HoverPanel.purpose: Preview panel on hover, focus and click
HoverPanel.props: label: string; summary: ReactNode; children: ReactNode; size?, open?, onOpenChange?, openDelay?, closeDelay?, className?

ComboBox.purpose: Searchable single choice with form value
ComboBox.props: options: readonly SelectionOption[] {value,label,disabled?,group?,icon?,color?,aliases?,description?}; label: string; value?, defaultValue?, onValueChange?, name?, placeholder?, disabled?, required?, clearable?, description?, error?, emptyMessage?, size?, variant?: surface|ghost, className?, focusRing?

MultiSelect.purpose: Searchable multiple choice with removable values
MultiSelect.props: options: readonly SelectionOption[] {value,label,disabled?,group?,icon?,color?,aliases?,description?}; label: string; value?,defaultValue?:string[]; onValueChange?: (values:string[])=>void; name?,placeholder?,description?,disabled?,error?,maxVisible?,size?,variant?:surface|ghost,focusRing?,className?,emptyMessage?; color?:Color|inherit (deprecated; chips stay neutral)

TagInput.purpose: Token entry with delimiter and duplicate handling
TagInput.props: label: string; value?, defaultValue?, onValueChange?, name?, placeholder?, description?, disabled?, error?, maxTags?, delimiter?, color?, size?, variant?: surface|ghost, focusRing?

RadioGroup.purpose: Accessible single choice group with card variant
RadioGroup.props: options: readonly RadioGroupOption[] {value,label,description?,meta?,disabledReason?,icon?,disabled?}; label: string; value?, defaultValue?, onValueChange?, name?, variant?: plain|cards|surface|ghost, orientation?: horizontal|vertical, layout?: list|grid, disabled?, error?, size?, focusRing?

ColorPicker.purpose: Palette and custom color choice with format conversion
ColorPicker.props: label: string; value?, defaultValue?, onValueChange?, name?, palette? (empty by default), showRecent?:boolean (false), swatches?, defaultSwatches?, onSwatchesChange?, maxSwatches?:number (7), background?, format?: hex|rgb|hsl|oklch, disabled?, description?, error?, size?, variant?: surface|ghost, focusRing?

NumberField.purpose: Steppable numeric field with bounds and optional suffix
NumberField.props: label: string; value?, defaultValue?, onValueChange?, step?, largeStep?, min?, max?, prefix?, suffix?, compact?, disabled?, readOnly?, error?, size?, variant?: surface|ghost, scrubbable?, scrubOrientation?: horizontal|vertical, focusRing?; other native input props except type/value/defaultValue/onChange/prefix
NumberField.behavior: Native number input keeps text editing and form semantics; browser spin buttons are visually hidden alongside custom steppers. scrubbable=true by default enables Alt+drag value changes; set false to disable. Arrow keys remain native.

ValueScrubber.purpose: Accessible numeric value control with Alt-drag scrubbing
ValueScrubber.props: label: string; value: number; onValueChange: (value:number)=>void; min?, max?, step?, orientation?: horizontal|vertical, disabled?, formatValue?, className?; useValueScrubber(options) available for composition
ValueScrubber.example: <ValueScrubber label="Zoom" value={zoom} min={50} max={200} step={10} onValueChange={setZoom} formatValue={value => `${value}%`} />
ValueScrubber.behavior: Slider supports arrow keys, Home/End, Alt+pointer scrubbing, Shift fine adjustment, pointer capture and cancellation rollback. Horizontal right and vertical up increase the value.

RichTextEditor.purpose: Controlled block editor with grip-only drag, insertion marker, block menu, marks and slash presets
RichTextEditor.props: label: string; value: RichTextDocument {blocks:RichTextBlock[]}; onValueChange: (document:RichTextDocument)=>void; presets?:RichTextPreset[] {type,label,keywords?,icon?,create?,render?}; placeholder?,disabled?,readOnly?,toolbarSize?:xs|sm|md|lg|xl,className?; source bridge exports: markdownToRichText, richTextToMarkdown, preserveMarkdownSourceEdit; RichTextBlock.markdown? preserves exact source

DataTable.purpose: Typed sortable and selectable table with optional pagination
DataTable.props: label: string; rows: readonly T[]; columns: readonly DataTableColumn<T>[]; rowId: (row:T)=>string; sort?,defaultSort?,onSortChange?,selectable?,selectedIds?,defaultSelectedIds?,onSelectedIdsChange?,page?,defaultPage?,pageSize?,onPageChange?,emptyMessage?,className?; surface?:base|canvas|raised|floating (omitted: inherit)
DataTable.example: <DataTable label="Projects" rows={rows} columns={columns} rowId={row => row.id} selectable />

FilterToolbar.purpose: Controlled search and removable field filters
FilterToolbar.props: label: string; fields: readonly FilterField[]; filters: readonly ActiveFilter[]; onFiltersChange: (filters)=>void; query?, onQueryChange?, className?

JsonViewer.purpose: Searchable JSON tree with paging and copy actions
JsonViewer.props: label: string; data: unknown; rootName?, expanded?, defaultExpanded?, defaultExpandDepth?, onExpandedChange?, searchable?, query?, defaultQuery?, onQueryChange?, pageSize?, maxHeight?, copyable?, onCopy?, onSelect?, showPath?, className?

ToastStack.props: items: ToastStackItem[] {id,title,description?,duration?,action?,tone?: neutral|info|success|warning|danger; color?: Color|inherit; appearance?: neutral|soft|solid (neutral); contrast?: boolean (false); surface?: inherit|base|canvas|raised|floating}; onDismiss: (id:string)=>void; position?:top-left|top-center|top-right|bottom-left|bottom-center|bottom-right|inline; expandDirection?:up|down|left|right; expanded?:boolean; onExpandedChange?: (expanded:boolean)=>void; label?,limit?,className?

AnnouncementBar.purpose: Rotating announcement with actions and countdown

CardStack.purpose: Keyboard and pointer review stack with undo

TextShimmer.props: children: string; active?, duration?, as?: span|p|div|h2|h3|h4, className?, id?

CommentThread.purpose: Threaded comments with replies, reactions and resolution
CommentThread.props: currentUser: CommentAuthor; comments?, defaultComments?, onCommentsChange?, people?, resolved?, defaultResolved?, onResolvedChange?, title?, reactions?, placeholder?, nowLabel?, className?

InlineComments.props: children: ReactNode; currentUser: CommentAuthor; people?, anchors?, defaultAnchors?, onAnchorsChange?, commentMode?, defaultCommentMode?, onCommentModeChange?, className?

BottomSheet.purpose: Inset modal sheet with handle gestures and snap heights
BottomSheet.props: Omit<DrawerProps,side|variant|children>; children?: ReactNode; variant?: inset|edge (inset); edgeGap?: number (12); snapPoints?: readonly number[] ([0.5,0.85]); snap?,defaultSnap?: number (index); onSnapChange?: (index:number)=>void; draggable?:boolean (true); handleLabel?:string; dismissThreshold?:number (120)
BottomSheet.behavior: Drawer supplies the only modal portal, focus trap, inert background and scroll lock. Handle-only gesture; content scrolling stays native. Snap indices target normalized ascending unique fractions 0.1–0.95. Keyboard Up/Down/Home/End change snap; Escape dismisses.

constraints: Use styles.css once; fonts are opt-in; no runtime dependencies beyond React peers
Prefer shared semantic roles and data-accent to per-hue tokens
Set global theme/borders on html; use explicit matching data-surface on custom containers; portals preserve local theme/accent/borders and use floating surface
Do not nest interactive elements inside ObjectCard or CollectionRow; use ContentCard for independent actions
Table does not sort or paginate by itself
Toast placement/lifetime, persistence, and global shortcuts belong to the consumer
Use DatePicker, NumberField, ColorPicker, Select or ComboBox for visible picker UI; avoid browser picker input types in finished interfaces; hidden native backing controls retain form semantics
source-tokens.css is historical audit data; full original palettes are canonical runtime primitives
Install a built .tgz from local pack or a release asset when available; git install is not supported because dist is ignored and prepare is absent
